items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: One thing that stands out in my mind, it was a cabaret or something, Pete Lollis.

ctx.x: Probably sang good though I bet.

And dance, she liked dancing. She was crazy about dancing. I remember in my early days my parents separated and I was raised by my mother and I was very young and I remember on various occasions that she would say, now you sure you're alright to stay at home by yourself? I was quite young. Yeah. And I would say, yeah, well you go on out and enjoy yourself. And she would come back and tell me about that. One thing that stands out in my mind, it was a cabaret or something, Pete Lollis. It was, it was down the,…
About Murray and the Custom House or I don't know.
